title: Foreign intelligence attempts to penetrate Brown's network

tellings.quote: instances that feel like foreign intelligence trying to penetrate my network and extract information, um, and also deliver threats.

plain: Matthew Brown, who is described as a Pentagon whistleblower, says he has had moments that felt like foreign spies trying to break into his circle of contacts to pull information out of it and to send him threats. He tells it from his own experience, without saying when or where, as a sign of how much interest his work draws.
